caption:
This samurai cat beat an entire ninja clan.
Every leap and slash here came from Seedance 2.5.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds. Aspect ratio 16:9. Photorealistic live-action with realistic cat fur and anatomy, wide-angle lens at ground level, soft overcast misty grey daylight, desaturated straw-gold reeds against a white-grey sky, light film grain, gritty samurai-film mood. Camera feel: dynamic low gimbal tracking at cat height, whip moves, slow motion on the aerial moments. Pacing: calm 2-second opening, then relentless fast action, then a calm hero walk-up ending.

CHARACTERS:
- THE SAMURAI CAT: a large orange tabby cat with darker ginger stripes, white chest, white chin and white paws, amber eyes, calm stern expression. Wears a wide woven bamboo conical straw hat (kasa) tied under the chin, and a katana in a black lacquered scabbard with a black-wrapped hilt and round gold guard slung diagonally across its back on a brown leather strap crossing its chest. In the opening a long dry reed stalk sticks out of its mouth. Same hat, sword and strap in every shot.
- THE NINJAS: about 10 adult men in all-black ninja outfits (black hoods and face masks with only an eye slit, loose black jackets and trousers), wielding katanas.

LOCATION: a vast marsh of tall dry golden-beige reeds, taller than a man, with feathery tops, bending in the wind; muddy ground with patches of green moss and fallen reed stalks; a huge moss-covered grey boulder; a calm grey lake inside the reeds with a small weathered wooden flat-bottomed rowboat; misty white-grey overcast sky.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.9) — The ronin. Medium close-up, three-quarter side view: the cat sits upright on a mossy rock, reed stalk in its mouth fluttering in the wind; very slow push-in; at 00:01.5 the cat turns its head toward the camera.
SHOT 2 (00:01.9-00:05.3) — The charge. Wide, ground-level low angle: the cat leaps down from the top of the huge moss-covered boulder, lands and sprints straight at the camera along a muddy path; the camera tracks backward low to the ground with heavy motion blur. At 00:03.0 the cat races between black-clad ninjas who lunge and stumble, weaving between their legs; at 00:04.5 a ninja's katana slashes across the foreground toward the lens; at 00:05.0 the cat bounds at the camera, front paws reaching forward.
SHOT 3 (00:05.3-00:06.9) — The duck. Ground-level side close-up, slow motion: the cat drops flat and slides on its belly, legs stretched forward, as a gleaming katana blade sweeps horizontally just above the brim of its hat. MUST SHOW: the steel blade crossing the top of the frame a few centimetres above the straw hat.
SHOT 4 (00:06.9-00:09.4) — Into the reeds. A fast whip pan through blurred reed stalks, then a low angle looking up: the cat springs vertically up through the tall reeds and leaps above their tops against the white sky, hat and sword silhouetted.
SHOT 5 (00:09.4-00:10.4) — Over the ninja. Low angle from behind a ninja's shoulder: the cat soars over his head, then flies across the frame from right to left past a swinging blade.
SHOT 6 (00:10.4-00:15.2) — The reed flip. Low angle, reeds whipping in the wind: the cat lands on a bundle of reeds and rides them as they bend low, then springs off; in slow motion it somersaults upside down mid-air, belly to the sky, the hat spinning. MUST SHOW: the woven underside of the straw hat facing the lens at 00:13.5. At 00:14.0 a masked ninja enters from the right and thrusts his katana horizontally; the cat twists over the blade right in front of his masked face.
SHOT 7 (00:15.2-00:17.8) — Through the legs. Ground-level tracking: the cat lands and dashes across mossy ground between the ninjas' legs; a ninja crouches and slashes downward behind it, missing; at 00:17.5 the cat runs away from the camera toward a wall of reeds.
SHOT 8 (00:17.8-00:19.3) — The leap. Low angle from behind: the cat launches straight up off a short wooden post, tail raised, and flies high above the reeds, seen from below against the white sky, getting smaller.
SHOT 9 (00:19.3-00:20.6) — The boat. High angle from above and behind: the cat drops toward a small wooden rowboat on calm grey water between the reeds and lands softly in its middle; rings of ripples spread around the hull.
SHOT 10 (00:20.6-00:30.2) — The last stand. Low locked-off camera at deck level at one end of the boat, looking down the length of the deck. The cat stands at the far end. At 00:21.0 about eight ninjas leap out of the reeds on both sides, flying toward the boat with swords raised; the cat jumps high and spins like a whirlwind in mid-air, katana flashing, white slash streaks radiating around it. MUST SHOW: the spinning cat with its round hat flaring, surrounded by flying ninjas at 00:21.5-00:22.5. The ninjas are blasted backward; at 00:23.5 the cat lands crouched in a wide low stance on the deck, sword back in its scabbard, as ninjas crash into the water on both sides with big white splashes. 00:24.5-00:27.0 the cat rises and walks calmly straight toward the camera down the deck; behind it the beaten ninjas float face-down in the grey water. 00:27.5-00:30.2 close-up: the cat stops right in front of the lens and stares into the camera, hat brim filling the top of the frame, flicks the tip of its tongue over its nose at 00:29.0, then holds a calm, stern stare.

SOUND: wind hissing through the reeds; soft thumps of paws landing; sword whooshes and steel swishes; reeds rustling and snapping; heavy splashes; an epic taiko-drum and bamboo-flute instrumental that builds through the fight and cuts out at 00:24.0, leaving only wind and water lapping against the boat. No dialogue, no text on screen.
prompt_short: 16:9 photoreal action. Orange tabby cat in a straw kasa hat with a katana on its back fights black-clad ninjas in a misty reed marsh: belly-slides under a blade, flips over swords, whirlwind spin above a rowboat, then walks calmly to the lens.
